paragraphs.text: And Ham divided amongst his sons, and the first portion came forth for Cush towards the east, and to the west of him for Mizraim, and to the west of him for Put, and to the west of [and to the west thereof] on the sea for Canaan.
paragraphs.original: ወከፈለ፡ ሐም፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለኩሽ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ለምሥር፡ ወቅርብት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለፉጥ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወቅርብት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለከንዓን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ባሕር፡
paragraphs.translit: wakafala ḥam ladaqiqu wawaḍʾa makfalət qadāmāwi lakuš mangala məśrāq waməʿrāb lamśər waqərbət lāʿlēhu lafuṭ mangala məʿrāb waqərbət lāʿlēhu lakanʿān mangala məʿrāb bāḥər

paragraphs.text: And Shem also divided amongst his sons, and the first portion came forth for Ham and his sons, to the east of the river Tigris till it approachcs the east, the whole land of India, and on the Red Sea on its coast, and the waters of Dedan, and all the mountains of Mebri and Ela, and all the land of Susan and all that is on the side to the Red Sea and the river Tina.
paragraphs.original: ወከፈለ፡ ሴም፡ ካዕበ፡ ምድሮ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለኤላም፡ ዘመንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ እምነ፡ ፈለግ፡ ጤግሮስ፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ሕንድ፡ ወውስተ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ቅሩበ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወውስተ፡ ማየ፡ ዳዲሽ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ኤትዮ፡ ምድር፡ ወመንገለ፡ መካን፡ ዘፋርስ፡ ወቤትሰዐድ፡
paragraphs.translit: wakafala sēm kāʿba mədro ladaqiqu wawaḍʾa makfalət qadāmāwi laʾēlām zamangala məśrāq ʾəmna falag ṭēgros ʾəska yəkayəd mangala məśrāq kʷəlu mədra ḥənəd wawəsta ʾērətrā bāḥər qəruba lotu wawəsta māya dādiš waykayəd kʷəlo mangala samēn waykayəd ḫaba yəkayəd ḫaba ʾētyo mədər wamangala makān zafārəs wabētsaʿad

paragraphs.text: And for Asshur came forth the second Portion, all the Asshur and Nineveh and Shinar and to the border of India, and it ascends and skirts the And for Arpachshad came forth the third portion, all the land of the region of the Chaldees to the east of the Euphrates, bordering on the Red Sea, and all the waters of the desert close to the tongue of the sea which looks towards Egypt, all the land of Lebanon and Sanir and 'Amana to the border of the And for Aram there came forth the fourth portion, all the land of Mesopotamia between the Tigris and the Euphrates to the north of the Chaldees to the border of of Asshur and the land of 'Arara.
paragraphs.original: ወለአሱር፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ካልእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ አሱር፡ ወነነዌ፡ ወሺንዐራ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኤፍራጥስ፡ ብሔር፡
paragraphs.translit: walaʾasur waḍʾa makfalət kāləʾ kʷəlu mədra ʾasur wananawē wašinʿarā waʾəska ʾēfrāṭəs bəḥēr

paragraphs.text: And there came forth for Lud the fifth portion, the mountains of Asshur and all appertaining to them till it reaches the Great Sea, and till it reaches Asshur his brother. And Japheth also divided the land of his inheritance amongst his And the first portion came forth for Gomer to the east from the north side to the river Tina; and in the north there came forth for Magog all the inner portions of the north until it reaches to And for Madai came forth as his portion that he should posses from the west of brothers to the islands, and to the coasts of the islands.
paragraphs.original: ወለአርፋክስድ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሣልስ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ብሔረ፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኤፍራጥስ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ማያተ፡ ገዳም፡ እስከ፡ ቀርብት፡ ለላዕለ፡ ለማእከለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ባሕር፡ መንገለ፡ ምድረ፡ ሐም፡
paragraphs.translit: walaʾarfāksəd waḍʾa makfalət śāləs kʷəlu mədra bəḥēra kaladāwiyān mangala məśrāq ʾēfrāṭəs qəruba laʾērətrā bāḥər wakʷlu māyāta gadām ʾəska qarbət lalāʿla lamāʾkala məśrāq bāḥər mangala mədra ḥam

paragraphs.text: And for Javan came forth the portion every island and the islands which are towards the border of Lud. Tubal there came forth the fifth portion in the midst of the tongue which approaches towards the border of the portion of Lud to the second tongue, to the region beyond the second tongue unto the third tongue.
paragraphs.original: ወለአራም፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ራብዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ መሶጶታምያ፡ ማእከለ፡ ጤግሮስ፡ ወኤፍራጥስ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ደብር፡ አሱር፡ ወምድር፡ አራራት፡
paragraphs.translit: walaʾarām waḍʾa makfalət rābəʿ kʷəlu mədər masop̣otāmyā māʾkala ṭēgros waʾēfrāṭəs mangala samēn ʾəmna mədər kaladāwiyān ʾəska yəkayəd ḫaba yəkayəd dabər ʾasur wamdər ʾarārāt

paragraphs.text: And for Meshech came forth the sixth portion, all the region beyond the third tongue approaches the east of Gadir. And for Tiras there came forth the seventh portion, four great islands in the midst of the sea, which reach to the portion of Ham [and the islands of came out by lot for the sons of Arpachshad as his inheritance].
paragraphs.original: ወለሊዶ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ኃምስ፡ ደብር፡ ኤሳው፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘያቀርብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መንገለ፡ ካሬያ፡ ወመንገለ፡ መካናተ፡ መንገለ፡ ቆስታ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡
paragraphs.translit: walalido waḍʾa makfalət ḫāməs dabər ʾēsāw wakʷlu mədər zayāqarəb lāʿlēhu mangala kārēyā wamangala makānāta mangala qostā wamangala məʿrāb

paragraphs.text: And thus the sons of Noah divided unto their sons in the presence of Noah their father, and he bound them all by an oath, imprecating a curse on every one that sought to seize the portion which had not fallen (to him) by And they all said, 'So be it; so be it ' for themselves and their sons for ever throughout their generations till the day of judgment, on which the Lord God shall judge them with a sword and with fire for all the unclean wickedness of their errors, wherewith they have filled the earth with transgression and uncleanness and fornication and sin.
paragraphs.original: ወከፈለ፡ ያፌት፡ ምድሮ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለጎሜር፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ እምነ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ይከይድ፡ ለመክፈልቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘመጋጎግ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wakafala yāfēt mədro ladaqiqu wawaḍʾa makfalət qadāmāwi lagomēr mangala məśrāq ʾəmna mangala samēn mangala tinā falag wamangala samēn yəkayəd lamakfaltu kʷəlu mədər zamagāgog mangala məśrāq zaykayəd kʷəlo mangala məśrāq

paragraphs.original: ወለማዳይ፡ ወፅአ፡ መካን፡ ለመክፈልት፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ወለያዋን፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ራብዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደሰያት፡ ወደሰያት፡ ቅሩብ፡ ለሊዶ፡ ወለቱባል፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ኃምስ፡ ማእከለ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ቤትፋራማ፡ ወለሞሰሐ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሳድስ፡ መንገለ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ቤትፋራማ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወለቲራስ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሳብዕ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ደሰያት፡ ዐበይተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡ ወከመዝ፡ ከፈልዎ፡ ለምድር፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኖኅ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ ወአምሐልዎሙ፡ መሐለ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኪደ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይተዐደው፡ ዕፆ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ መሐለ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መርገመ፡ ለለ፡ ዘይዘምድ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ አሜን፡ አሜን፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለዓለም፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ በዕለታት፡ ኩናኔ፡ ከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይተዐደው፡ ዕፆ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወባረኮሙ፡ ኖኅ፡ አምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወባረከ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ዘፈለጠ፡ ለሎሙ፡ ዕፆሙ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
